name: four step chips build the pipeline, then two go live
looks: A small wordmark fades in at the top corner as a one-line promise appears: one flow, full control. Beneath it, four rounded step chips (plan, build, verify, ship) build left to right, a thin arrow drawing on between each pair. The first two chips then swap to an active green fill, with a short caption clipping in beneath naming what that unlocks.
build: Chips pop in on scale 0.92->1, power3.out, staggered 0.12-0.18s left to right, each preceded by its connecting arrow drawing on. The active-state swap recolours the first two chips' fill and border on power2.inOut under 0.3s; the caption clips in via a collapsing clip-path inset just after.
sound: A soft click per chip landing, a tick on each arrow draw, a brighter chime as the active chips light up.
prompt: Introduce the brand, then build a short pipeline of step chips left to right, a thin arrow connecting each pair as it lands. Once the full line is built, swap the steps already handled into an active colour and clip in a short caption naming what that gives the viewer.
